scientific_question: At the full 200x-valid paired-MLP budget, can activation-conditioned routing over four complete procedural nonlinear MLP atoms reproduce each terminal dense expert function where static bases, weight-coordinate decoders, and multiplicative context gates failed?

theory_reconciliation.measured_boundary: Static/tangent learned bases peak near 0.43 heldout recovery at the 200x boundary; the functionally fitted TT reaches 0.25-0.27; shared and expert-specific paired-coordinate decoders reach about 0.10 and 0.206, with negative JVP. All are stable enough to identify representation failure rather than noise.
theory_reconciliation.direction_drift: Crossed same-gauge audits show that useful expert directions depend on the activation bank and rotate almost completely across fitted endpoints. A static decoded matrix image is therefore the wrong object even when decoder sharing is removed.
theory_reconciliation.why_not_more_global_fht: Fixed global FHT/sign mixers with learned spectra, learned butterfly frames, ProductFHT residuals, and maximum-budget two-sided KFAC have already been tested and rejected. This candidate does not add FHT depth or another static matrix chart.
theory_reconciliation.architecture_change: Replace each dense expert MLP by an input-conditioned mixture of four complete procedural nonlinear atoms. Each atom contains its own fixed seeded full-rank FHT c_fc and c_proj path; learned diagonal gains calibrate both sides, while a compact router changes the active function with x.
theory_reconciliation.why_context_gate_is_not_repeated: The rejected context gate multiplied an otherwise linear c_fc map, producing a poorly aligned quadratic perturbation. Here conditioning mixes complete GELU nonlinear functions after their residual outputs are formed; it is a direct sum in function space, not a multiplicative insertion into a linear target.
theory_reconciliation.mapping_connection: The learned state is still a smooth layer-wise compact latent state: gains, hidden bias, and router coordinates modulate fixed orthogonal procedural atoms. The target architecture is changed to make its compact functional atlas state-adaptive, which is the measured missing property.
theory_reconciliation.not_lora_or_dense_basis: No dense c_fc, dense c_proj, dense base, learned dense dictionary, additive residual, or dense optimizer state is retained. Fixed atom matrices are never stored; signs plus normalized FHTs generate their actions procedurally.

source.terminal_gauge: Use the exact terminal model, outer routing, dense complete-expert target, and fixed discovery/heldout token banks used by the two sealed paired-coordinate controls.

expert_coordinate_result.finding: Expert-specific decoders improve mean recovery to 0.203061/0.208861 but remain far below 0.80 and preserve negative JVP.

maximum_budget_kfac_result.finding: The maximum admissible 3+4 two-sided static chart reaches only 0.433036/0.426122 mean recovery, establishing the strongest stable 200x static control.

candidate.name: four_complete_procedural_atoms_with_activation_router
candidate.outer_router_scope: The source top-2 router is unchanged and independently counted. Every c_fc and c_proj matrix of all eight complete experts is removed by the candidate.

same_run_control.name: static_mixture_of_identical_complete_atoms
same_run_control.single_difference: Set the activation-router weight matrix to zero and freeze it; fit only one input-independent four-way router bias per expert plus the identical gains and shared hidden bias.
same_run_control.purpose: Measure whether state-adaptive atom selection, rather than four fixed atoms and diagonal calibration alone, supplies the missing function direction.

data_protocol.sampling: Reuse exact terminal outer routing and deterministic per-expert sampling. Candidate and static control receive identical discovery inputs and targets.
data_protocol.anti_leakage: Fit discovery A and B independently. Heldout tokens and JVP probes never affect coordinates, stopping, initialization, thresholds, or candidate selection.

fit_protocol.optimizer: AdamW on all counted gains, shared hidden biases, and eligible router coordinates
fit_protocol.objective: Equal-expert normalized residual-output MSE plus 0.10 normalized analytic input-JVP MSE.
fit_protocol.selection: Use the final registered step. No heldout selection, atom-count/seed/router-width/LR/step/gain/threshold sweep, retry, or warm-start from heldout values.

evaluation.primary: Exact outer-routed dense-teacher residual-output recovery on untouched heldout activations.
evaluation.local: Analytic input-JVP recovery, including the derivative of the inner atom router, on an independent frozen Rademacher protocol.
evaluation.expert: Score every source expert before outer top-2 mixture aggregation.
evaluation.stability: Compare heldout outer-routed actions from independently fitted discovery A/B candidates by cosine.

decision_rule.pass: Passing every gate in both banks authorizes only a production implementation/count/correctness phase and a separately preregistered initialization-plus-Mapping-Loss shadow. It does not authorize LM training directly.
decision_rule.fail: Reject four conditionally routed complete procedural atoms with the exact gain/router allocation. Do not sweep atom count, atom seeds, router width, gains, LR, steps, regularization, or thresholds. Return to theory before another full-MLP candidate.
decision_rule.systems: Run an exact two-step GPU preflight. If projected or observed full runtime exceeds five minutes, use a verified terminal/error-only @Codex watcher launched through examples/nanogpt/launch_local_detached.py.
